items.exampleEn: I propose that we meet again next week.
items.exampleZh: 我提議我們下星期再開一次會。

items.exampleEn: Many people have the wrong notion that English is too hard to learn.
items.exampleZh: 很多人有個錯誤的觀念，以為英文太難學。

items.exampleEn: Experts estimate that the bridge will cost ten million dollars.
items.exampleZh: 專家估計這座橋要花一千萬美元。

items.exampleEn: The hotel called to confirm our room for Friday night.
items.exampleZh: 飯店打電話來確認我們星期五晚上的房間。

items.exampleEn: The main appeal of the city is its food.
items.exampleZh: 這座城市最大的吸引力是它的美食。

items.exampleEn: There was strong opposition to the plan to close the park.
items.exampleZh: 關閉公園的計畫遭到強烈反對。

items.exampleEn: A university degree is a requirement for this job.
items.exampleZh: 大學學歷是這份工作的必要條件。

items.exampleEn: I trust her judgment because she has a lot of experience.
items.exampleZh: 我相信她的判斷，因為她很有經驗。

items.sentenceEn: Can you confirm the time of the meeting?
items.sentenceZh: 你可以確認一下開會時間嗎？

items.audioEn: I estimate that about fifty people will come to the party.
items.audioZh: 我估計大約有五十個人會來參加派對。
items.questionZh: 說話者估計有多少人會來？

items.sentenceEn: There was little opposition, so the plan went ahead.
items.sentenceZh: 幾乎沒有人反對，所以計畫照常進行。

items.sentenceEn: The beach has a special appeal for families with young children.
items.sentenceZh: 這片海灘對有小孩的家庭特別有吸引力。

items.stemEn: Please ____ your email address so we can send the ticket.
items.stemZh: 請確認您的電子郵件地址，以便我們寄送票券。

items.stemEn: Good ____ is important when you choose a business partner.
items.stemZh: 選擇生意夥伴時，良好的判斷力很重要。

items.passageEn: The town council proposed building a large shopping mall next to the river. They estimated that it would bring a substantial number of new jobs. However, there was strong opposition from local people. Many of them had the notion that the mall would harm the river. The council has now confirmed that a study is a requirement before any building starts. The final judgment will be made by the council next year. For now, the river keeps its natural appeal.
items.passageZh: 鎮議會提議在河邊蓋一座大型購物中心。他們估計這能帶來相當多的新工作機會。然而，當地居民強烈反對。很多人認為購物中心會破壞河流。鎮議會現在已確認，任何工程開始之前都必須先做研究。鎮議會明年才會做出最後的判定。目前，這條河仍保有它天然的吸引力。

questions.questionZh: 鎮議會現在確認了什麼？
options: 計畫已經被市政府取消
一定會增加五百個工作

referenceEn: I propose that we go by train.
I propose taking the train there.
rubricZh: propose 可接 that 子句或動名詞（例如 propose that we go、propose taking）
「搭火車」可寫 go by train、take the train 等
寫 suggest 意思也正確

items.promptZh: 這只是一個大概的估計，實際的價格可能更高。
referenceEn: This is only a rough estimate; the real price may be higher.
It is just a rough estimate. The real cost might be higher.
rubricZh: 用 estimate（名詞）表示「估計」（例如 a rough estimate）
「實際的價格」可寫，例如 the real price、the real cost 等

resolvedAfterFinalReview.message: 執行長第②③關裁示修正：第②關：議會的決定用 judgment 要點明由誰做出
resolvedAfterFinalReview.resolution: 改前："The town council proposed building a large shopping mall next to the river. They estimated that it would bring five hundred jobs. However, there was strong opposition from local people. Many of them had the notion that the mall would harm the river. The council has now confirmed that a study is a requirement before any building starts. The final judgment will come next year. For now, the river keeps its natural appeal."；改後："The town council proposed building a large shopping mall next to the river. They estimated that it would bring a substantial number of new jobs. However, there was strong opposition from local people. Many of them had the notion that the mall would harm the river. The council has now confirmed that a study is a requirement before any building starts. The final judgment will be made by the council next year. For now, the river keeps its natural appeal."
